props.text: Automation badge: the small corner badge of an automation symbol, drawn on its own (mode and type).
Hydraulic check valve: a display-only glyph on a hydraulic diagram.
Analog two-way valve glyph: the valve with its opening, without readout or alert frame.
Analog three-way valve glyph: the valve with two openings, without readout or alert frame.
Battery indicator: a battery drawn as a level bar or a trend graph, display only.
Engine indicator: an engine block drawn in a static, regular or enhanced scheme, display only.
Atmospheric tank indicator: a tank drawn as a level bar or a trend graph, display only.
Automation readout: a value with its unit in a bordered chip, display only.
Heat exchanger: a specialty tank with a hot and a cold side, badges and alert frame, display only.
